raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 is the only source_tz='UTC' batch (327 rows), but silver_transactions treats every txn_ts as America/Chicago local time, so those UTC timestamps are read as local and shifted about 6 hours late. Rows that are really 18:00-24:00 Chicago on 2026-01-17 land on 2026-01-18 at 00:00-06:00, which is the 72-row alert. Converting UTC-sourced timestamps to Chicago local time in silver_transactions fixes this, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, t.local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(t.local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN ((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
